title: The Thunder Toad
summary: With the Immortal Realm gate about to open and the sects hunting for treasures, Wang Lin prepares, starting with refining his restriction flag again. He does it inside the Land of the Ancient God, inside Tuo Sen's body, betting that heavenly tribulation cannot reach there; the bet pays off and the flag ends one step short of medium success. Using the Hunyuan Beast Control Ring, he subdues a Thunder Toad, a top-grade spirit beast that was fighting a wild beast, though the ring keeps drawing on his spiritual power. He then passes through Wuwen, a level-3 cultivation country, into the collapsed Outer Region Battlefield full of wandering souls, where the envoy Sun Wen bows to him in fear. A year later his three sword sheaths are refined with his primordial soul, and as the gate opens the old man reminds him to use the straw hat while telling children how the Ancient Gods died and the Immortal Realm shattered.
events: Wang Lin begins preparing for the Immortal Realm
